_comment: Single data source for Questionnaire A (registered teams that did not submit), rendered by src/feedback-registered.njk and src/zh/feedback-registered.njk through src/_includes/questionnaire-a-form.njk. Every question, option code, condition and both languages live here, so the two pages cannot drift; scripts/verify-questionnaire.mjs fails the build if the built pages still differ in field names, option codes/order or conditions. Participant-facing text is verbatim from Questionnaire_A_spec_bilingual.md (sha256 6b1e4284…9b57d) plus the two approved closed-state lines. `options` is either an inline list or the key of a shared set in `optionSets`. `showIf` is a list of {field, anyOf} tests OR'd together; a hidden question is disabled (never submitted) and cleared. `num: true` marks the questions that take a sequential display number (always-visible spec questions; conditional follow-ups are unnumbered). The page closes itself at `closesAt` (end of 22 Oct 2026 AoE).
subject: EBiM feedback — registered teams (A)

description.en: This questionnaire is for teams that registered for the EBiM Benchmark Competition 2026 but did not file a Phase I submission.
description.zh: 本问卷面向已报名 EBiM Benchmark Competition 2026 但未提交第一阶段作品的队伍，约需五分钟。

intro.en: This questionnaire is for teams that registered for the EBiM Benchmark Competition 2026 but did not file a Phase I submission. It takes about five minutes. Every question is optional, and you do not need to give your team name. Everyone on your team is welcome to answer — one response per person. It closes on 22 October 2026 (AoE).
intro.zh: 本问卷面向已报名 EBiM Benchmark Competition 2026 但未提交第一阶段作品的队伍，约需五分钟。所有问题均为选答，也无需填写队名。欢迎贵队每位成员分别填写，每人填写一份。问卷于 2026 年 10 月 22 日（AoE）截止。

switchLine.en: To answer in 中文, switch language before you start — switching reloads the page.
switchLine.zh: 如需使用 English 作答，请在开始前切换语言；切换会重新加载页面。

privacy.en: We use your answers only to improve future EBiM competitions and to report on this edition in aggregate. Answers are shared with sponsors only if you tick the box above, and then without your name or team; we also remove names from free-text answers before sharing. Your email address, if you give it, is used only for what you ticked. We don't sell your information. Submissions are processed by Web3Forms.
privacy.zh: 您的回答仅用于改进今后的 EBiM 竞赛，以及以汇总形式报告本届情况。只有在您勾选上方选项时，回答才会与赞助方分享，且不含您的姓名和队名；分享前我们也会删除自由填写内容中的姓名。如您留下邮箱，仅用于您勾选的用途。我们不会出售您的信息。表单由 Web3Forms 处理。

thanks.en: Thank you. We have your answers. If you asked to join the email list or to talk with us, we'll be in touch at the address you gave.
thanks.zh: 感谢您的填写，我们已收到您的回答。如您选择加入邮件列表或参加后续交流，我们会通过您留下的邮箱与您联系。

error.en: Your answers could not be sent. Please try again, or email them to organizers@ebim-benchmark.org.
error.zh: 提交未成功。请重试，或将您的回答发送至 organizers@ebim-benchmark.org。

noscript.en: JavaScript is required to submit this form (the spam check needs it). If you can't enable it, email organizers@ebim-benchmark.org.
noscript.zh: 提交本问卷需要启用 JavaScript（反垃圾验证需要）。如无法启用，请发送邮件至 organizers@ebim-benchmark.org。

closed.en: This questionnaire closed on 22 October 2026. Thank you to everyone who answered.
closed.zh: 本问卷已于 2026 年 10 月 22 日截止。感谢所有填写问卷的朋友。
